subject.title: Sunol Glen Unified School District Board

text: My education and qualifications are: As a mother, grandmother, and longtime member of our community, I believe our children deserve a safe, respectful learning environment where they can focus on reading, writing, math, science, and preparing for a successful future. I am not a career politician. I am a parent who understands the responsibility of helping children grow into capable, kind, and responsible adults. Raising a family has taught me that common sense, accountability, and compassion matter. While no one is perfect, life experience has given me the wisdom to recognize both the challenges our children face and the importance of protecting their hearts, minds, and futures. If elected, I will listen to parents, teachers, students, and our community. I believe every child deserves the opportunity to learn in a positive environment where they feel safe, respected, and encouraged to reach their full potential. I am running because I care deeply about the next generation. My goal is simple: to put students first, support academic excellence, practice fiscal responsibility, and help ensure our schools remain places where children can learn, grow, and thrive.

text: My education and qualifications are: I am honored to be a candidate for the Sunol Glen School Board because I care deeply about our students, school, and community. My two daughters attended Sunol Glen School for three years, and although they have since moved on, our family remains actively involved in Sunol through the Sunol Girl Scout troop and the Sunol 4-H program. Professionally, I lead global cybersecurity compliance and physical security programs for Quanta Computer in Fremont. My work includes collaborating with executive leadership, managing complex programs, developing policies, and ensuring accountability across global operations. These experiences have strengthened my leadership, strategic planning, and decision-making skills, which I believe will benefit our school district. If elected, I will focus on supporting academic excellence, student safety, fiscal responsibility, and open communication between families, educators, and the community. I believe every student deserves a safe, inclusive, and inspiring learning environment where they can succeed. It would be an honor to serve on the Sunol Glen School Board and help ensure our school continues to provide outstanding opportunities for every student.

text: My education and qualifications are: Sunol Glen School brought our family to Sunol 27 years ago. Drawn to this small town and small, high-performing school where everyone knows your name and helps your child thrive, our daughters attended K–8, receiving an exceptional education. Education has always been my family’s core value—my parents were a college professor and middle school teacher. I believe K–8 is the foundation for every child’s future. As Sunol Glen looks toward its next 100 years, I am running for Sunol Glen School Board to protect its legacy honoring generations of educators and Sunolians, preserve its uniqueness, and strengthen what keeps it exceptional and independent. I respectfully ask for your vote. I bring 34 years of business and technology experience at a Fortune 10 company, developing governance processes focusing limited resources on top priorities, turning plans into results by shaping strategy, building portfolios, benchmarking projects. This discipline, and my MBA and MS in Computer Science, directly support school board responsibilities. Degrees in Earthquake Seismology, Marine Geophysics, and Geology further prepare me for facilities and safety oversight. I serve as Treasurer of the Kilkare Woods Association, growing reserves and building multi-year asset plans. I’ve become a trusted advocate for a disabled friend’s business affairs.

text: My education and qualifications are: As a Sunolian for over 20 years, I respectfully ask for your support to serve our community as a member of the Sunol Glen School Board. I am a product of California’s public education system. I attended public schools through high school before returning to college as an adult. I earned a Bachelor’s in Applied Mathematics from California State University, Bakersfield, and a Master’s in Statistics from the University of California, Santa Barbara. I devoted my career to public education, retiring in December 2025 after 25 years with California Community Colleges. I began as a Professor of Mathematics and Statistics and most recently served as Dean of Science, Technology, Engineering and Mathematics at Contra Costa College. In that role, I led faculty and staff, managed budgets, and oversaw hiring and evaluation processes. I also helped guide the successful completion of a $72 million Science Center bond project. I am a mother, grandmother and aunt who has supported children through Sunol Glen, and I’m committed to ensuring every Sunol Glen student receives a high-quality education in a safe, supportive, and fiscally responsible environment. I would be honored to bring my experience and skills to serve our students, school, and community.
